description: KALAMAZOO, MI (WKZO AM/FM) – The current chair of the Kalamazoo County Commission is hoping to make a move to Lansing next. Jen Strebs  officially announced her bid for the 41st District State House seat Friday. Current Representative Julie Rogers will be seeking state Senate seat currently

title: Kalamazoo County Commission chair announces bid for State House — Jen Strebs
